lead_raw_text:
The structure of Rb6Nb2Cl12 (reduced formula Rb3NbCl6) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3m (No. 166), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Nb in octahedral coordination by six Cl neighbors and Rb in two environments: one six-neighbor Cl octahedral environment and a 12-neighbor close-packed-like arrangement. Cl centers show three geometric neighbors, and the periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals edge-sharing between Nb and Rb octahedra, corner- and face-sharing between Rb octahedra, and corner-sharing between Nb and 12-vertex Rb polyhedra.
